title: EMV Additional Information Data Layouts
applicability: Applies to EMV additional-information data associated with Segment 100/130 transactions and EMV responses.

businessRequirements.title: EMV Additional Information Table ID 001 shall use the source-defined length and EMVYES/EMVNOT request values.
CARC Additional Information Table ID 002 shall carry the one-character Card Authentication Results Code returned by Visa.
EMV Table Data included in an authorization response shall be echoed in subsequent advice or batch-upload requests when required by the source.

testCases.positive: EMVYES or EMVNOT uses Table ID 001
CARC uses Table ID 002 and one-character result
Response EMV data is preserved into required follow-up message

testData.reason: EMVYES/EMVNOT is a fixed enumerated value; fully synthesizable.
CARC is a one-character format check; the value itself is a network-returned result, not cryptographic material.
Echo-preservation is a byte-for-byte carryover check across messages; synthetic EMV Table Data is sufficient.

testDataReadinessSummary.note: No cryptographic material is involved in this appendix; all rules are synthesizable.

testDataStatus: No dedicated EMV Additional Information response artifacts are currently available yet, but none require a live/external fixture; synthetic AI-generated data is an acceptable path.
remaining: Author synthetic EMV response/advice artifacts covering Table IDs 001/002 and echo behavior.
